items.title: Document asset layering and compatibility contract
items.context: Define project-local required assets versus package registry prompt templates versus generated/cache materialization, including legacy mirror compatibility and no-overwrite rules.
items.userSees: 用户阅读 docs/requirements/decisions/lifecycle-artifact-scope.md 时能看到 registry-backed prompt assets、project-local required assets、legacy mirror compatibility 和 safe migration/no-overwrite 的明确分层说明。

happy.desc: Docs define project-local required assets, package registry prompt templates, generated/materialized caches, and legacy mirror compatibility.

edge.desc: Docs explicitly preserve legacy full-mode .Codex/.claude mirrors and explain thin mode is opt-in, not a silent default migration.

adversarial.desc: Docs state migration must not overwrite or delete local edits unless Koala can prove STALE_SAFE ownership.

items.title: Implement package prompt registry and host renderer
items.context: Expose versioned agent prompt metadata, template hashes, and host-specific rendering for Claude and Codex without changing legacy prompt files yet.
items.userSees: 用户运行 registry smoke 时看到所有 package agent templates 都被列出，Claude render 与模板一致，Codex render 与 legacy transform 一致，并输出 pass。

happy.desc: Registry enumerates every package template agent with stable id, path, sha256 hash, and host render outputs.

edge.desc: Registry behaves deterministically when template directory exists through package templates rather than repo-local .claude symlinks.

adversarial.desc: Codex rendered output remains byte-compatible with the legacy renderCodexAgentContent transform so legacy mirrors are not silently changed.

items.title: Make Codex verification and managed asset checks registry-aware
items.context: Allow legacy mirror mode and new registry mode to pass hard verification, preserving existing process-event gate evidence and clear drift diagnostics.

items.title: Add opt-in thin init asset mode
items.context: Support init/check paths that keep project assets lightweight by writing manifests and launchers while avoiding default prompt copies when registry mode is selected.

items.title: Validate legacy compatibility and thin mode behavior
items.context: Run focused smoke tests, build/type checks, init fixtures, managed asset checks, and Codex adapter verification proving existing full mode is unaffected.
